These are main-thread-resolved ground DTO snapshots from the actual Stage 7/8 rendered triangle audit on 2026-09-06. They preserve model anchors and selected surfaces; they are not survey data. Stage 8 accepts 8 BC entrances, 2 Harbour bays and 4 Convention entries. Tests also use an explicitly synthetic flat 1.2 m fixture to verify absent-ground rejection. No network, external runtime files or fallback guessed ground is used.
